description: Seeded-defect PRs against benchmarks/sample_repo. Each case changes one file; `expected` lists the defects a correct reviewer must report. Clean cases (expected = []) measure false positives. Splits: dev (the original 11 cases; already inspected during development), validation (for tuning), holdout (never used for tuning; headline results). Labels were written before any model saw the validation/holdout cases. Severity/type labels of dev cases were added later and are not used for headline claims.
